name: photochain
description: PhotoChain – blokklánc-alapú hitelesítéssel működő fotó-marketplace (szakdolgozati prototípus)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix blockchain && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run design:test && npm run test --prefix blockchain && npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --prefix server && npm run coverage --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix blockchain && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix e2e
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run design:test && npm run test --prefix blockchain && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
